What Does the Fed's April Rate Decision Signal for 2026?

summary: FOMC held rates at 3.5-3.75% on April 29, 2026 (8-4 vote). Last time 4 members dissented was Oct 1992. Market pricing: 0 cuts in 2026, one 25bp cut in Dec 2027. Powell's last meeting as chair — he stays on the board. Elevated inflation partly from energy prices.
